name: Well-Guarded Mind (Abbey of the Golden Sparrow)
body:
Guard duty at the vault trained your mind to guard against chaotic attacks.

Benefit: You gain a +1 trait bonus to your saving throws against spells or spell-like abilities with the [chaotic] or [mind-affecting] descriptors.
